referee_caveats_inferred: Gas mass depends directly on the adopted alpha_CO = 2.5 and on an unresolved CO(1-0) profile assumed equal to [CII]; Toomre Q and f_gas inherit this.
j* relies on gas rotation curve applied to stars, an extrapolated outer stellar profile and an assumed n=3 bulge; uncertainty budget is not described.
Bulge mass (B/T~0.2) comes from an n=3 decomposition with a possible unmodelled bar, so the M_BH/M_bulge comparison is uncertain.
The spiral/bar interpretation of 0.2 arcsec [CII] data with blended components is qualitative; no independent kinematic model of the bar is fitted.
Single object; claims about general proto-cluster behaviour are extrapolations.
